summary: Implemented the Decathalon datalist loader. Added monai/data/decathalon_dataloader.py with load_decathalon_datalist and private helper _resolve_path; exported it from monai/data/__init__.py via an explicit import; added a "Decathalon DataLoader" tilde-underlined subsection with an autofunction entry in docs/source/data.rst; and added tests/test_load_decathalon_datalist.py with class TestLoadDecathalonDatalist containing four tests. Verification was by reading only: no tests or black were run, per instructions, and I measured that no line in the three Python files exceeds 120 columns. Nothing was committed. Choices beyond the spec: a non-list value under the data key raises ValueError, and a non-object top-level JSON value raises ValueError as a missing-key error.
